name: Makwa Lake Provincial Park - Mewasin Campground
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-19. Every Mewasin paging row reads 'Near Water - no'. Esri World_Imagery z17 (0.70 m/px), two frames with all 36 SKPP GIS points: the west arm M13-M25 runs along the southwest shore of Jumbo Lake's south bay under continuous spruce/aspen canopy; water-mask distances to the open-water edge M15 22 m, M13 24 m, M17 24 m, M19 32 m, M21 34 m, M23 36 m, M25 42 m (canopy overhangs that edge); the east loops M1-M12 and M26-M36 lie 38-112 m back in forest behind the beach and road. SKPP site photos (read 2026-11-19): the lake shows through trees and shrubs from M13, M15 and M21 (glimpses from M25), not from M11, M12, M17, M19 or M23; no site on open ground to the water. The view rests on M13 (32 ft), M15 and M21 (40 ft). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica SKPP parkId 290500, Mewasin loop, read 2026-11-19 (paging table + every site's detail page): 25 Nightly Non-Electric + 11 Seasonal Non-Electric = 36 site-specific sites M1-M36; every site books a unit of 25 ft or more ('Maximum Equipment Length' 40 on 21, 32 on 9, 25 on 6); M6 and M19 Pull-Thru. Park map (2026-04-10) draws Mewasin Beach campground at the south end of Jumbo Lake on the road to Exner Lake, 3.2 km centroid to centroid and 4.5 km by road (OSRM) from Stabler Point. A real public drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
note: The park's southern campground, at Mewasin Beach on the south bay of Jumbo Lake, about 3 km south of Stabler Point (own entry) on the road to Exner Lake. Wooded sites in two parts either side of the beach; the lake shows through the trees from a few west-arm sites (M13, M15, M21). 11 sites are sold by the season. --Claude

season.note: 2026 dates; 2027 dates not yet published. No fall or winter camping at Makwa Lake.

name: Makwa Lake Provincial Park - Jumbo Beach Campground
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-19. Every Jumbo Beach paging row reads 'Near Water - no'. Esri World_Imagery z17 (0.70 m/px) and z15 with all 16 SKPP GIS points: the loop is a strip between the Loon Lake road (east) and Jumbo Lake's northeast shore (west), the lake about 1 km wide there; water-mask distances to the open-water edge J9 7 m, J10 14 m, J8 17 m, J6 20 m, J12 20 m, J3 21 m, J5 23 m, J2 24 m, J4 and J7 25 m, J11 and J13 27 m, J15 32 m, J14 35 m, J16 37 m, J1 39 m, through a shore strip of aspen and shrub with gaps (leaf-off imagery). SKPP site photos (read 2026-11-19): J1 (open gravel to a table at the bank, lake beyond), J2 and J6 (open grass to the shore) are on open ground to the water; J3 too but it books 18 ft only; the lake shows through trees from J4, J5, J10, J14 and J16; J7-J9, J11-J13 and J15 face forest. Lakefront on the few-sites rule, resting on J1 (40 ft), J2 (25 ft) and J6 (32 ft). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica SKPP parkId 290500, Jumbo Beach loop, read 2026-11-19 (paging table + every site's detail page): 16 Nightly Non-Electric site-specific sites J1-J16; 15 book a unit of 23 ft or more ('Maximum Equipment Length' 40 on 9, 32 on 3, 25 on 3), J3 18 ft. Park map (2026-04-10) draws Jumbo Beach campground on its own loop road off the road to Loon Lake and Hwy 26, joining it at both ends; 1.12 km centroid to centroid from Stabler Point across the bay and 5.8 km by road (OSRM). A real public drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
note: The park's small campground on the northeast shore of Jumbo Lake, beside the road into Loon Lake village and about 1 km northeast of Stabler Point (own entry) across the bay. Wooded sites between the road and the water; only J1, J2 and J6 (and J3, which books 18 ft or less) sit on open ground to the lake, the rest look at it through trees or not at all. --Claude
